title: Stockfish, But It Loses 300 ELO When I Give Check
summary: 'Panic Fish': Stockfish starts at 3600 and loses 300 Elo every time the player puts its king in check. Game 1: player sacrifices pieces for early checks (Qb3+ drops it to 2700) but is mated and loses. Game 2: player plays more solidly, collects checks gradually (first check -> 3300), survives a lost position (mate-in-6 for black) as the weakened engine misses it, swings to +8 and defeats Panic Fish (81% accuracy).
rules: Every time the player's move gives check to the bot's king, the bot loses 300 Elo.
Official site: -300 applied when bot is in check after the player's move, floor 0; at 0 the bot plays random legal moves; strength scaled by rating buckets.
win_condition: Checkmate the bot. Video: game 1 loss, game 2 win.
